title: Scrape Save omits naming, delays confirmation, and opens an unusable filing browser
severity: S2: central capture workflow is confusing and slow; users cannot name the Source at save time
preconditions: Use the installed development extension in Chrome on a content page with a captured article; sign in and select an organization.
reproduction: Open Scrape, capture the page, click Save.
Observe that no editable Source name or destination choice appears before the write.
After Saved, inspect the automatic filing panel: Library selector, broad eight-type browse list, and a second File action.
Try to scroll the Projects list to a project beyond the first visible rows; the list does not scroll to it.
Observe the additional wait between the Source landing and the Saved state.
expected: A compact save dialog immediately offers a prefilled editable name and a fast optional destination choice; one primary Save lands the named Source with selected associations and shows confirmation promptly. Project search and scrolling reach every result. Full browsing and Library loading occur only on request.
actual: Save lands with page-derived name and no associations. A post-save panel loads Libraries and a broad association browser; filing needs another call, and its Projects list does not scroll to later entries. The UI also waits for an ancillary SEO audit INSERT after landing before showing Saved. Exact backend/database latency is not yet measured.
evidence: User-provided Scrape and filing screenshots plus report that the Projects list does not scroll (2026-10-09, captured in task)
cause: The extension discards name/attach_to inputs already accepted by /sources/land, makes the association picker a separate eager post-save step, and serially awaits an ancillary SEO audit write.

transition_history.reason: User reported and supplied screenshots of confusing, delayed save.
Source trace reproduces absent name/destination and serial audit/picker loading.
Bounded client implementation assigned; native retest required.

closure_requirement: Fresh peer checks product/source behavior; guarded development build is reloaded in installed Chrome; member/admin real-page save proves custom name, no destination, one and multiple destinations, optional Library, refusal/retry, duplicate rename, responsive confirmation, and scrolling/searching to select a project beyond the first visible rows; surrounding Scrape cases remain green. Guest sign-in flow is rechecked.
next_action: Implement and peer-check compact pre-save flow, then native installed-extension retest and update inventory T04/T29.
